story.hookTemplate: Your Lagna sets the stage for all 12 houses—yet one specific planet quietly steers how the world reads your first impression.
story.reflectPrompt: Notice how you naturally enter a room or start a new project today.

story.hookTemplate: In Jyotish tradition, your Moon sign shapes your inner weather far more than your Sun sign—especially when the sky shifts every 2.25 days.
story.reflectPrompt: What calmed your mind or drained your focus most noticeably today?

story.hookTemplate: Beyond the 12 zodiac signs lie 27 lunar mansions. Your birth star sets the starting clock for every Dasha chapter of your life.
story.reflectPrompt: Does the symbol or mood of your birth star feel familiar in how you recharge?

story.hookTemplate: Your Moon reflects how you feel, while your Sun points to what gives you steady backbone—even when plans get tested.
story.reflectPrompt: Where did you feel a quiet sense of purpose or pride in your effort today?

story.hookTemplate: Your 1st house describes your baseline temperament—but the house where its ruler actually sits shows where your energy naturally flows.
story.reflectPrompt: Where did your attention pull you without forcing it today?

story.hookTemplate: Classical texts pair savings and speech in the exact same house—suggesting what you value and how you speak move together.
story.reflectPrompt: Notice one conversation or spending choice today that felt grounded.

story.hookTemplate: Before big breakthroughs happen, the 3rd house tracks small daily acts of initiative, skill-building, and courage.
story.reflectPrompt: What small step did you take today that felt slightly outside your routine?

story.hookTemplate: Your 4th house holds what restores your nervous system—home, roots, and inner quiet—often contrasting sharply with your public life.
story.reflectPrompt: What space or routine helped you exhale at the end of the day?

story.hookTemplate: Creative sparks, mentorship, and discernment all live in the 5th house—revealing how you turn raw effort into original ideas.
story.reflectPrompt: Log one moment of curiosity or playful thinking from today.

story.hookTemplate: Often misunderstood as obstacles, the 6th house is actually your engine of daily craft, service, and steady resilience.
story.reflectPrompt: Which daily habit kept your day steady despite minor friction?

story.hookTemplate: Sitting directly opposite your 1st house, the 7th house acts as a mirror—showing the qualities you seek in close partners and allies.
story.reflectPrompt: How did a one-on-one conversation reflect your mood back to you today?

story.hookTemplate: The 8th house governs research, shared resources, and quiet inner transformations that only make sense in hindsight.
story.reflectPrompt: Notice a subtle shift in perspective you would not have had a month ago.

story.hookTemplate: Your 9th house points to teachers, long horizons, and the quiet philosophy that turns experience into wisdom.
story.reflectPrompt: What principle or long-term view guided a decision today?

story.hookTemplate: Your Moon shows how you feel inside, but your 10th house reveals the public role and work rhythm your chart naturally gravitates toward.
story.reflectPrompt: Did that land? Log how your energy felt during work hours today.

story.hookTemplate: The 11th house connects sustained effort with networks, communities, and the fruit of long-running goals.
story.reflectPrompt: Who in your wider circle offered helpful momentum or perspective recently?

story.hookTemplate: Every cycle needs a quiet exhale. The 12th house governs solitude, sleep, behind-the-scenes work, and letting go.
story.reflectPrompt: Where do you need a little unscheduled quiet tonight?

story.hookTemplate: Two people born on the same day can live very different decades depending on which planetary chapter is active right now.
story.reflectPrompt: Does the theme of your current planetary chapter match what has been center stage lately?

story.hookTemplate: Chapters rarely change overnight—often the tone begins shifting weeks before the exact Antardasha boundary.
story.reflectPrompt: What feels like it is winding down vs. quietly waking up in your week?

story.hookTemplate: While the Moon shifts every two days, Saturn and Jupiter stay in a sign for 1 to 2.5 years—marking the long seasons of your chart.
story.reflectPrompt: Where are you playing a patient, multi-month game right now?

story.hookTemplate: Often feared in folklore, Sade Sati is classically a season of maturity, pruning noise, and building things that actually last.
story.reflectPrompt: What responsibilities feel clearer or more non-negotiable for you this year?

story.hookTemplate: Your D1 birth chart is the tree; divisional charts like D9 and D10 zoom into the fruit—revealing hidden strength that the main chart hides.
story.reflectPrompt: Notice any area where your quiet staying power surprises people.

story.hookTemplate: Most apps stop at scary labels. Classical Jyotish checks cancellation rules (Bhanga) first—and many apparent Doshas are naturally balanced.
story.reflectPrompt: How does viewing challenges as balanced rather than fixed change your perspective?

story.hookTemplate: Every chart distributes 337 Ashtakvarga points across 12 signs—explaining why the same transit feels effortless in one area and heavy in another.
story.reflectPrompt: Which domain of life feels naturally well-supported when you lean into it?

story.hookTemplate: Beneath every plain-English insight sits a transparent mathematical engine—degrees, sub-lords, Sahams, and full calculation tables.
story.reflectPrompt: If you enjoy seeing the mechanics behind patterns, explore any system in the Tools room.
